other_conditions: Bonafide valid commercial driving licence and badge required for Light Motor Vehicle
Applicant must not have been declared a defaulter under any scheme of DSFDC, Nationalized Bank, Financial Institution, or Co‑operative Bank
Annual family income should not exceed ₹1,20,000 per annum for SC, OBC and Minority categories
For the creamy layer of the Minority category, the maximum income ceiling is ₹6,00,000 per annum
No income limit prescribed for Safai Karamchari category
benefits_summary: Term loans up to ₹5,00,000 for purchase of Light Motor Vehicles, repaid over 60 months with a six‑month moratorium.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
Demand draft of ₹350 processing fee in favor of DSFDC
